title: Walking on Sunshine - 30A Five Star Properties
description_expanded:
🏡 Newer Construction – Modern design with high-end finishes and comforts! 🏖 Prime Location – Steps from the community pool & minutes to public beach access with ample parking & restrooms. 🚗 6-Seater Golf Cart Included – Cruise to the beach, restaurants, and shops with ease! 🏝 Beach Chairs Provided – No need to pack extra—relax in comfort on the sand! 🍽 Close to Stinky’s Fish Camp – A local favorite for fresh seafood & great vibes. 🌅 Ultimate Relaxation – Enjoy the perfect beach getaway with all the conveniences nearby!
